description: Implement the core Flutter app: theme system, Supabase service, routing, auth flow (login/register screens with real Supabase auth), and the main app shell with bottom navigation.
steps: Create lib/core/constants/app_constants.dart with app name, Supabase config (read from env/dart-define), color hex values (primary orange-red: #FF5722 or similar premium warm tone, background white, surface colors)

Create lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart with premium ThemeData: custom ColorScheme, TextTheme using Google Fonts (Inter or Poppins for headings, body), elevated card styles, custom button themes, input decoration themes. No stock Material look.
Create lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart with the color palette as a class of static constants
Create lib/core/theme/app_text_styles.dart with text style definitions
Create lib/services/supabase_service.dart - singleton service that initializes Supabase client using Supabase.initialize() with URL and anon key from dart-define or hardcoded fallback constants
Create lib/core/widgets/app_bottom_nav.dart - premium floating bottom navigation bar with 4 tabs (Home, Campaigns, Shop, Profile) using Iconsax icons, with smooth animations and active indicator
Create lib/app.dart with MaterialApp.router using GoRouter, the custom theme, and route configuration
Create lib/main.dart that initializes WidgetsFlutterBinding, Supabase, then runs the app
Create lib/core/router/app_router.dart with GoRouter config: splash, login, register, home shell with bottom nav (home, campaigns, shop, profile tabs), and nested routes

Create lib/features/auth/screens/login_screen.dart - premium login screen with email/password fields, Supabase signInWithPassword, error handling, link to register. Clean white design with orange-red accent buttons.
Create lib/features/auth/screens/register_screen.dart - premium register screen with name, email, password, role selection (Creator/Brand), Supabase signUp, then insert into users table with role
Create lib/features/auth/screens/splash_screen.dart - animated splash with Rexo logo, checks auth state and redirects
Create lib/features/auth/providers/auth_provider.dart - Riverpod providers for auth state, current user, sign in, sign up, sign out
Create lib/core/widgets/app_shell.dart - the main scaffold with bottom nav that wraps authenticated screens
acceptance_criteria: lib/main.dart initializes Supabase and runs the app
lib/app.dart uses GoRouter with proper route definitions
Login screen calls Supabase signInWithPassword and handles success/error
Register screen calls Supabase signUp and inserts user record into users table
Bottom navigation has 4 tabs with Iconsax icons and animated transitions
Theme uses custom colors (orange-red accent on white) and Google Fonts, not stock Material
GoRouter redirects unauthenticated users to login and authenticated users to home
All dart files have proper imports and no syntax errors
verification: Read lib/main.dart and verify it has Supabase.initialize call
Read lib/features/auth/screens/login_screen.dart and verify Supabase auth call
Read lib/core/router/app_router.dart and verify route guards
Check all .dart files in lib/ compile (no obvious syntax issues like unclosed brackets)
